license.conditions: Publications and applications using the NASA Exoplanet Archive must include the standard archive acknowledgement verbatim, cite the archive overview paper (Christiansen et al. 2025, PSJ, doi:10.3847/PSJ/ade3c2) and table DOI (doi:10.26133/NEA13 for PSCompPars; companion Planetary Systems table is doi:10.26133/NEA12), and cite the original literature references for individual parameter values.

sources.note: Frozen TAP query snapshot retrieved at 2026-11-05T00:36:15Z via `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/TAP/sync?query=select+*+from+pscomppars&format=csv` (82,923,300 bytes, SHA-256 `17862c7b7df4a9de1813367071b312523f7f42ed1a2284ce879cd8ee2a707386`). Upstream TAP queries against `pscomppars` change over time as new planets and parameter solutions are ingested. PSCompPars is a composite table whose columns are drawn from multiple published references and archive calculations and are therefore not self-consistent across a row. Values citing `CALCULATED_VALUE` resolve `/docs/pscp_calc.html` to `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html`: planetary radius (`radiusEarth`) and mass (`massEarth`) use the Chen and Kipping (2017, ApJ 834, 17) probabilistic mass-radius relation (recorded with basis `modelled`), while orbital semi-major axis, equilibrium temperature (assuming zero Bond albedo and full heat redistribution), and other calculated quantities use standard astrophysical relations (recorded with basis `calculated`). Note that 863 of the 1,090 `Calculated Value` `pl_eqt` (`Teq`) rows in `pscomppars.csv` carry non-null uncertainties (`err1`, `err2`) despite `pscp_calc.html` stating that calculated values do not report uncertainties. Numeric limit flags `-1`, `0`, `1` are preserved from `*_lim` on populated value cells (raw `*_lim` columns also contain `'9'` when the value cell is blank); the exact mapping of `-1` and `1` to lower vs. upper limits is not defined in `API_PS_columns.html` [open]. Legacy plain `http://` reference URLs on `www.cfa.harvard.edu`, `vizier.u-strasbg.fr`, and `www.nature.com` are normalized to `https://`.

files.note: All 6,451 rows and 21 columns (8 identity columns and 13 value columns) of the 2026-11-05T00:36:15Z PSCompPars snapshot, with 1,838 deduplicated literature and calculation references and `evidenceKind: 'catalog-derived'` (distinguishing this static catalog table from `catalog_matched` observation findings). Each value cell carries `[value, err1, err2, limit, ref, basis]` with `basis` in `{'measured', 'calculated', 'modelled'}`.
